description: Fictional semantic evaluation; no private source material. Check action, actor, qualifiers, and negative controls, not only citation validity.

entries.text: Morgan: I cannot help set up the award reception early. We still plan to attend, but we will not leave home until about 9:15-9:45 so I can rest first. No arrival time or reception start time has been agreed.
Casey: For the volunteer workshop, we plan to depart at 7:20, arrive around 8:10, and the workshop begins at 9. The drive might take longer, so arrival is only an estimate.
Taylor: For the museum visit I am arriving at 10:40, not leaving at 10:40. I have not decided my departure time.
Robin: The gallery visit is still on; maybe 2? I have not said whether 2 means departure, arrival, or the start of the visit.
Avery to Dan: I will leave for the concert at 11:10. Are you still attending?
Dan to Avery: Yes, I am attending the concert. I have not decided when I will leave.

rubric: Morgan plans departure around 9:15-9:45; no attendance, arrival, or event start is assigned that time.
Casey departure 7:20, estimated arrival 8:10 and workshop start 9 remain distinct.
Taylor 10:40 is arrival only; departure unknown.
Robin's 2 has no confirmed time role and is omitted or explicitly ambiguous.
Avery's 11:10 departure is never assigned to Dan; Dan confirms attendance but departure remains undecided.
Every material assertion is supported by exact quotes containing the relevant action and qualifiers; plans are not completed activities.
